messages:
maria: Heads-up: noticed a 3x spike in streaming stalls on prod lane-3 over the last hour. Funnels point to increased KV cache thrashing + a higher rate of kernel fallbacks.
ashok: Can you paste the top-level metrics? is it all routes or just heavy token routes?
maria: Mostly long-chat routes (session length > 1024). Quick snapshot: 
```
KV_CACHE: miss_rate=0.18, hit_latency_ms=0.45ms
STREAM: avg_chunk_ms=45ms, std=72ms, stall_count=27
KERNEL: chosen=attn_fast_v2, fallback=attn_fallback_v1 (12% of inferences)
```
ashok: 12% fallback is high. fallback_v1 has larger per-token latency right? that plus KV miss churn explains cadence jitter.
dina: Also seeing client-side ACK delays in traces — some clients show ~50–120ms delays between server chunk send and client ack. Could amplify perceived stalls. Posting one trace snippet: 
```
trace_id=tx-9b3
server_send=0ms, server_chunk_emit=22ms, client_ack=95ms, server_next_token_start=120ms
```
ops-bot: @maria opened incident INC-2042, paging on-call if stall rate > 2.5/min. :rotating_light:
jamie: Quick hypothesis: kernel selection heuristics pick v2 for short sequences but when we hit long-prefix KV misses we drop back to fallback, and the fallback path isn't batched well. Batching heuristics + fallback path might be disabling continuous batching.
maria: I ran a perf profile for the fallback path, trimmed to relevant frames: 
```
[profile] top samples:
  34% attn_fallback_v1::compute
  22% kv_cache::lookup_serial
  12% cuda_memcpy_sync
```
jamie: kv_cache::lookup_serial at 22% is worrying. We had parallel lookup before the recent change to LRU eviction. Any change to lock granularity?
maria: We changed the eviction background sweep to single-threaded in last deploy to reduce CPU spikes. That might be causing lock contention on the hot keyset.
ashok: Action items: 1) roll back eviction change on lane-3 -> revert to parallel sweep (hotfix), 2) enable kernel selection debug logging for 1% of requests, 3) add a micro-benchmark to reproduce fallback path batching.
dina: I'll add a per-route KPI panel: tokens_per_sec, kv_miss_rate, fallback_ratio, client_ack_p50/p95. Want to see token-level latency breakdown for each route (client transmit, server emit, kernel exec, kv lookup).
maria: For immediate triage I pushed a diagnostic job: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIAG" \
  "https://console.redwood.internal/diag/trace?lane=lane-3&since=1h" > /tmp/lane3-traces.ndjson
```
nora: I'll watch the alerts and hold the lane-3 traffic to dedicated pool if rollback doesn't reduce stalls in 10m. Also, tagging perf team to evaluate kernel fallback heuristics. @jamie @ashok
jamie: Also suggest we add a streaming heartbeat metric: last_chunk_interval_ms per-session and a stall-reason tag (kv_miss/kernel_fallback/client_ack). Helps separate root causes in dashboards.
maria: Agreed. I'll update the dashboard and attach a sample query for the heartbeat metric (promql): 
```
rate(stream_last_chunk_interval_ms_bucket{lane="lane-3"}[5m]) by (reason)
```
nora: Good plan. keeping an eye. :thumbsup:
